children.text: Cultural Day at SAIS - Abu Dhabi brought the whole school together to celebrate the heritage of the United Arab Emirates. Students in traditional dress performed folk dances, recited poetry and presented displays on Emirati crafts, food and hospitality.

The event was led by the Student Minister of Culture & Knowledge Development and supported by teachers from the Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies departments. Parents joined the celebration and enjoyed a showcase of student work in every classroom.
Celebrations like this one reflect our commitment to honouring local traditions while nurturing globally minded learners.

children.text: Congratulations to the SAIS - Abu Dhabi Middle School football team, who reached the final of the inter-school tournament after an unbeaten group stage. The team finished as runners-up following a closely contested final.
Coach and players trained on our outdoor courts throughout the term, and their discipline and sportsmanship were praised by the tournament organisers.
Sports at SAIS - Abu Dhabi build teamwork, resilience and school pride. We look forward to cheering the team on in the next competition.

children.text: The Kindergarten hall was transformed into a theatre for the annual puppet show, where SAIS - Abu Dhabi teachers performed favourite stories for KG1 and KG2 students. The children joined in with songs, answered questions from the puppets and retold the stories in class afterwards.
Storytelling and dramatic play are central to our Kindergarten curriculum, supporting early literacy in English and Arabic, listening skills and imagination.
Thank you to our Kindergarten team for a morning full of laughter and learning.

children.text: Led by the Student Minister of Environment, students from Elementary and Middle School spent a morning planting fig trees, herbs and flowering plants in the SAIS - Abu Dhabi school garden. Each plant now carries a label with a QR code linking to information researched by the students themselves.
The planting day is part of a wider sustainability campaign that includes recycling drives, water-saving initiatives and eco-awareness assemblies throughout the year.
Service projects like this one connect our students with their community and foster the civic responsibility that sits at the heart of student life at SAIS - Abu Dhabi.

children.text: The science labs at SAIS - Abu Dhabi were buzzing with activity as students across grade levels presented their STEM projects to teachers, parents and classmates. Highlights included electrostatics demonstrations, environmental investigations and 3D-modelled prototypes designed in our ICT classes.

STEM at SAIS - Abu Dhabi is a mindset embedded across the curriculum rather than a single club. Students are encouraged to explore, build, test and innovate, connecting scientific principles with real-world applications.
We thank our science and technology teachers for guiding every project, and congratulate the students on the curiosity and creativity they brought to the showcase.
